notes.title: Treasure Chest Rewards Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/b6a476f173d70445842d91143b695b6f700f7a51.jpg[/img]

Treasure Chests are here!  Pass quizzes to get the following:
[list]
[*] 60% = Wood Treasure Chest: elements that make up the chest
[*] 70% = Bronze Treasure Chest: 2 coins + elements that make up the bronze chest
[*] 80% = Silver Treasure Chest: 4 coins +  silver (which makes up the chest)
[*] 90% = Gold Treasure Chest: 8 coins +  gold (which makes up the chest)
[*] 100% = Diamond Treasure Chest: 16 coins +  the element that makes up the chest
[/list]
These rewards are in addition to the ability points and medals that are already awarded for completing quizzes.  The treasure chests can be collected repeatedly by passing the quizzes repeatedly.  The quizzes are different per attempt, and pull 10 questions from a list of 25 questions.  This is the April Fools event reward, and is planned to remain in the game!  I plan to add stuff to buy with the coins soon.  You can currently see how many coins you have by seeing how much cobalt you have - I plan on adding a coin display soon as well.

Try flying through the comet tail, it is really cool to be coated in frozen comet dust! notes.title: Twitch Stream and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/27f6d3d60698ab4fc1363d2b1427b91ab41d0d06.png[/img]

I have fixed a few more bugs that Real_Bytes_Gaming found on her Twitch stream.  Planetary Settlers is streaming tonight at midnight (technically 1/25/2021) Eastern Standard Time at: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/real_bytes_gaming]https://www.twitch.tv/real_bytes_gaming[/url]
[list]
[b]Bug fixes include:[/b]
[*] Fixed issue with brightness on Uranus and Neptune (now it doesn't get extremely dim when looking near / at the sun, but it now properly dims a little bit).  Brightness throughout the two levels is also better.
[*] Mostly fixed character facing the wrong way when exiting portals.
[*] Updated the controls menu to include the new ability to use the F key (or E key), whichever you desire, as the action button.
[*] On Uranus: made ship engine flames less laggy, and turned them off when parked.  This prevents the lag spike that was observed in the last stream in the hanger.

[b]Feature updates include:[/b]
[*] Updated title screen with the vast majority of the title screen visible now (and not hidden by the game saves menu).  Click the Game Saves menu, then make your selection - as before, or Resume Game to resume your current game.
[*] Updated Credits page
[*] Clarified Nanites are what gives you your ability points - it shows up in the menu now as Ability Points (Nanites).  They are microscopic robots that can be used to upgrade Blue-42's abilities, and are able to be re-allocated as desired in the abilities tab.
[/list]

Here's a tip for those that have made it this far: It can be a big help to adjust your ability points to meet the current challenge, like, for a race, you can turn down things you don't need at the time, and max out speed.

A second tip: Speed also affects your speed in the air!  If you need more control in the air, try to max your speed out.  If you need more (or less) lift, adjust your jet pack.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Space Slug Stirrings
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/884b302b443878e51df3defeddb0120ea9665dbe.jpg[/img]
We rescued the Mimzy the space slug on Mercury, but she inked us in the process, leaving behind a big mess!  I didn't know they could ink!  Can you find her (on Mercury) and check to make sure she is doing okay?  It seems she, and other space slugs have undergone some interesting changes as well:
[list]
[*] We also discovered a strange shell near where she was stuck, apparently the space slugs molt!
[*] We think all the space slugs have molted, and moved.  Try to confirm this.  Try to find their shells and new locations! [b] If you find any (slugs or shells), take a screenshot (F12) and share it with the community![/b]  If it is a new space slug in the outer solar system, you can also name it in your community post (keep it clean though), and it will eventually learn to speak its name!
[*] There are also rumored to be albino space slugs now, if you find one of those, please share a screenshot for further research!  Once one is found, we can do more research and find out more!
[*] They have grown the ability to show emotion, via their colors!  [b]The frequency of the light increases with more positive emotion.[/b]  Their veins now glow a certain color, and pulse with their heart beat!
[/list]
[b]Space slug emotions (by vein glow color):[/b]
[list]
[*] Red = Angry
[*] Yellow = Scared or sad
[*] Green = Happy
[*] Blue = Excited (very happy)
[*] Violet = Overjoyed!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/d5df1954671a8abb1e3e29039073198a21f5800e.jpg[/img]
Mimzy was angry right after we rescued her... could it be something to do with the inky mess she made?

For the second year anniversary of Planetary Settlers, I thought I would share some details on how development has been going!  Here is the good, the bad, and... the lessons!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/13689efa5e1ecd43f693c04bfed8413f278dfed1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/a75775e3c05c39e9ea5818930b3caec8e251284c.png[/img][/url]

[b]The Good[/b]
[list][*] Planets are in - All the planets are available now to visit, there is a level for each planet of the solar system (and a couple more levels - the sun and moon).
[*] All positive reviews - All reviews of Planetary Settlers have been positive so far!
[*] More features - I have added more features than I originally planned!
[*] Beta! - Planetary Settlers is now in Beta, and I plan to fully release it in about a year!
[*] Financial Improvement - Planetary Settlers sales have been somewhat increasing, and I turned a slight profit for the first time, though I am still not out of the woods.  The situation is improving though, and I am optimistic it will continue to improve!
[*] Found - All the space slugs of the inner solar system have been found, but none of the outer solar system ones have been found.  You can still be the one to discover those, post a picture to the community page if you find one.  This will unlock further rewards for all the players, and you can name the pet too (just keep it kid friendly).
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/20e7737cf03ca4446da41f0e2d71aee6a843c04d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/2fbd95ae38efd258682ac69ca805c789e90d67c5.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]The Bad[/b]
[list][*] COVID-19, finances and ulcers - oh my!  These have come together to create the "perfect storm" of worry.  I am personally learning to put my trust in God though, which I need to do before the worry further deteriorates my health, so I can start healing!
[*] Family illness - The whole family got really sick earlier this year after visiting a convention to look for ways to market Planetary Settlers.  I am very thankful it wasn't COVID-19 - it was just a bad flu, and I am thankful we all pulled through.
[*] Burnout - I was getting burned out, but I am fine now.  I was overdoing it, needed to scale back my efforts a bit, and at least observe the Sabbath (Friday sundown to Saturday sundown).
[*] Not enough reviews / sales - I am still under the required number of reviews to have a recommended score for Planetary Settlers.  I also don't have enough sales to make Steam trading cards yet. 
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/7c2d801e21788ca88c11417be77c6b06fbb595c7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/688314a99ba551a18a5cc3e77c783d0699784f2e.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]The Lessons[/b]
[list][*] Focus on the good, and learn from the bad!
[*] Follow God!
[*] Keep going!  If it is a worthy cause you are working on (I feel Planetary Settlers is) and is feasible, don't give up on your dream, keep going!  If it isn't, find something else you enjoy that is a worthy cause!
[*] Go at a steady pace, don't over do it (or under do it)!
[*] Work with others - family, friends and you - the community - have provided a number of good ideas that have greatly enhanced Planetary Settlers (though still observe social distancing and local guidance while we deal with COVID-19).
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/928a628227751b6fd25a9df86ad844866ce7dd64.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/9b3b04269b27a37ee9d0ebab6e04b8b4cbbf5c83.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]The Future[/b]
Since you made it this far, here are my goals for the fairly near future:
[list] [*] Polish the graphics / look and feel - adding more furniture and artwork to the levels, and adding particle effects, quest line, etc...
[*] Give crafting a bigger role (it is currently used in the Jupiter base repair mission).
[*] Add more missions to the existing levels, to include crafting missions and more missions for the outer solar system!  My goal is to have 10 missions per planet.
[*] Add verbal dialogue.
[*] Further test and fix more bugs.
[*] Possibly add more levels to highlight different parts of the planets.
[*] Possibly implement health / fall damage, battery power, and pickups to replenish health and battery power.
[*] Add levels for some of the more interesting moons, an asteroid, and a comet!
[*] Add more achievements.
[*] Translate to other languages.
[*] Make it available over more platforms.
[*] I am optimistic about the future of Planetary Settlers - I am marching toward full release, and I have the ability to press on!
[/list]

notes.title: Autopilot Fleet and... Beta!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/67e0ae2ee871b629e47399c186da181af2375840.jpg[/img]

There are some new space ships that need their autopilot tested out!  Are you willing to help test their autopilot programming?  Step up on to the ship in the hangar and near the "?" mark to trigger the autopilot.  The ships are supposed to fly around in formation, controlled completely by auto pilot.  Just ride one and see if you can collect all the waypoints!  If the test runs smoothly, they may even attempt to have you transfer between the planes!

I now consider Planetary Settlers to be in Beta!  I plan on adding a number of other missions, fixing bugs, adding a few more levels, and adding more features.  I feel it is moving more from the development phase into the polishing phase, to improve the look and feel, etc...  I still have a lot of new content planned.  I am hoping to do a full release of the game in about a year!

Features include:
[list]
[*] Uranus Fleet Flight Mission
[*] Added Jet Plasma Trails
[*] Planetary Settlers is entering Beta!
[*] Multiple bug fixes - the most major bugs are now fixed (for now, hopefully it stays that way)!
[*] Cleaned up missions in the outer solar system
[*] Improved lighting (some areas still need more work)
[/list]

notes.title: Good Sport Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/892a7b02574de7e1e64c3625667450f612bad21a.png[/img]
[list][*] Now you can find and unlock different sports balls (5 total, in addition to your regular ball) to launch!  Once unlocked, find them under your Ability tab!
[*] In Normal mode, sports balls are unlocked by finding a hidden console (hidden in secret areas), where you walk up to download the blueprint.  Once you find a blueprint, you can launch the balls by pausing, going to the Abilities tab, and selecting your desired ball (lower right corner).  When you left click, you will now launch this as a projectile!
[*] If you want immediate access to them, you can go play in Open Exploration mode, where they are already unlocked.
[*] Customize their color under the Color tab!  Select Projectile, then pick your color.  You can pick a color from the menu, or make your own color with the RGB sliders.  You can also select Glow, and make the ball glow in the dark, whatever color you pick!  Hint - try sliding it on the RGB bar down to a low value if you want an authentic glow in the dark look (otherwise it will be bright enough to glow brightly in the day light, which you may want to try as well).  While you are here, might as well mess with your light color!  While this was here already, it is a lot more fun to try with different sports balls!
[*] Multiple bug fixes and improvements have been made as well.  The way points on the alien mission are now brighter / easier to see, and now you can walk right up to the edge of the moon dome (inside and outside).
[/list]
Thank you all for being good sports during this trying time!   Together as a society, I am sure we will get through this.  Hopefully this update brings some happiness as well!

notes.title: First Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/410125f48b6295d349c398da09a4b94e447fe605.png[/img]

Today is the first anniversary of Planetary Settlers, and it has been quite the journey so far, filled with some good moments, bad moments, and really funny moments.  As a solo indie developer, I thought I would share the highlights of my experience.  Here are the highlights over the last year of the good, the bad, and the funny!

[b]The Good:[/b]
[list]
[*] I had a lot of fun making the game so far, over the past 3 years.
[*] Planetary Settlers was accepted and released for Early Access 1 year ago!
[*] Received positive reviews so far
[*] It feels great to get my first big time game out there after so much work on it (I have made many smaller games from childhood, but this is my first truly meant for prime time).
[*] It feels great to put something out there that can really help people.  It is a fun, family friendly game that has the added benefit of teaching about the solar system, based on the Standards of Learning objectives.  I believe kids playing this will likely improve their science grades, and that adults will also get a lot of fun and enjoyment out of it.  I look forward to adding the remaining levels, adding more features, and polishing it up for full release.
[*] I am very thankful for the support of friends, family, go fund me donors, and everyone who bought the game!
[/list]

[b]The Bad:[/b]
[list]
[*] Finances... I had hopes and expectations that I would make a lot of money off this, but I haven't even broken even yet (though I am getting close, not counting development time).  I have been hoping Planetary Settlers would supplement our income to help me and my wife get out of debt.  We nearly went bankrupt earlier, but have managed to halt our downward spiral, so it isn't all bad.  I have hopes that my continued work on this, and full release of Planetary Settlers when it is done will give us that boost we need to get out of debt.
[*] Bugs... Like nearly all software, Planetary Settlers hasn't been immune to bugs.  The worst bugs so far were: once the initial dialogue for Mars got associated to the Sun level dialogue, and a save game from the Normal Mode slot would occasionally move over to the Free Exploration Mode slot.  I implemented fixes for both of those though very quickly after discovery.  I have also fixed many lesser bugs, and still have more lesser bugs to fix.  That is part of the journey in software development.
[*] I haven't had enough reviews to have a review score for Planetary Settlers.  Thankfully the reviews received have been positive so far!
[*] I haven't met the sales threshold to be able to release trading cards for Planetary Settlers.  Enough of the bad, lets move to... the funny!
[/list]

[b]The Funny:[/b]
I have had a few funny experiences as well:
[list]
[*] Figured out you can grind up puzzle pieces on Pluto, which kind of hampers your progress.  If encountered, you could fix it by restarting the level, but now you get an achievement for trying to do it (in addition to getting your piece back with some funny dialogue)!  Puzzle Smoke, don't breathe this!  This achievement is in honor of "Will it Blend" which is one of my favorite YouTube series!
[*] The Exploding Bed Blooper: I imported a bed (public domain) from TurboSquid.  I successfully imported it into the game, and then...  I tried to make it physical, with the thinking that it would be neat to be able to pull the pillows off.  I also had it really large so I could see the finer details of he bed.  Here are the results of that "adventure":
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eb_Zxw2G9MA&list=PL9Bk1v7iJfdCpRaQ6vTGYOM-lXAO7RAQ1&index=23]Exploding Bed Blooper![/url]
[*] Found out that throwing things, particularly furniture, in low G has some rather entertaining results, as shown here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZzSRlVBTPmE]Throwing chair off sky scraper![/url]
[*] Yes, there is a subtle "Uranus" joke in the game somewhere, can anyone find it?
[/list]

[b]The Future:[/b]
For those that have read this far, here's a sneak peek of what I plan to add:
- New levels (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and possibly more!)
- New projectiles (paint balls, various sports balls)
- New crafting objectives (e.g. craft repair parts, craft projectile factories)
- Ability to repair the bases and make them habitable
- More achievements
- Improved look and feel
- Optimized performance
- Other languages
- Possibly more!

notes.title: Level-Up-Date

[list]
[*] [b]Save game slots[/b] - 10 save game slots have been added!  If you have an existing save game, it will appear under slot 6.  The date and percentage will update once you open / save the game.  Slots 1-5 are Normal Mode, and Slots 6-10 are Open Exploration Mode!
[*] [b]Normal Mode[/b] - Here, your ability points count, and this is how Planetary Settlers was originally envisioned!  As you complete challenges, you earn ability points that allow you to increase your skills, and shield against harsher environments / solar radiation. It is effectively a level-up system.  Upgrade and reconfigure Blue 42 under the ability tab!  Simply select a new save under the Normal Mode tab to begin!
[*] [b]Open Exploration Mode[/b] - Lets you explore the solar system without most of the restrictions, and is the way Planetary Settlers has existed so far.  Any already existing save game is located in Slot 6.
[*] [b]Updated look and feel[/b] - Replaced the cartoony looking rocket, and redesigning Blue 42's look to not be cartoony.  I realize that while the cartoon look appeals to kids, it does not appeal to adults.  I plan to make Planetary Settlers look more realistic, appealing to both kids and adults!  If you like the rocket, it is still preserved as a toy / decoration!
[*] [b]Updated music[/b] - I added music to the title screen, as well as replacing the music of Venus (I got feedback that the old Venus music was not very good, but I think the new song is much better).

notes.title: Collectibles and Elements!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/3a1f71a8e4b23230efc6a87d01cc20f0ea0c554b.jpg[/img]
Collectibles and elements have arrived!  I have added various collectibles throughout Planetary Settlers!  These will be instrumental in crafting, which I plan to add in a future update, so start collecting!  Whatever you collect is teleported to the Pluto Element Factory (via a portal mounted on Blue 42) and converted to its basic elements.  Check the pause menu - resources tab to see how much of each element you have collected.  Collectibles currently include:
[list]
[*] Ingots - copper, silver, and one hidden gold ingot
[*] Diamond rings
[*] Air canisters
[*] Iron Ore
[/list]
As an added bonus, you will likely become familiar with the periodic table and learn some basic chemistry principles as you play!  These are the real elements as we know them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/50e464c34fa3b940b5d88d88aa6303befeb2aebe.jpg[/img]

In future updates, I plan to add many more collectibles.  I also plan to make it so you can craft upgrades for your robot, craft miner robots, and ultimately create buildings, water, air, and objects to support colonies throughout the solar system!

notes.title: Graphics Update - Settings from Retro to Epic
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/795361f940bb827423ae583a8ecb2bc62293c288.png[/img]
I have made it so you can access the graphics menu in game, instead of having to go back to the title screen to make adjustments.  Just pause (p) and go to the Graphics tab.  Pick your desired settings and press Apply.  I have also added 4 new graphics presets (fastest running first):
[list]
  [*] [b]Retro[/b]: Do you like the feel of the old time games?
Go to Graphics, click "Retro" and enjoy a look that is a "blast from the past!"  This is the fastest frames per second built in setting.
  [*] [b]Fast[/b]: This is designed to run fast, use this setting or retro if you are lagging while playing Planetary Settlers.  Fast optimizes the graphics to run fast while still looking halfway decent.
[*] [b]Default[/b]: This is the way Planetary Settlers used to run before I added graphics options.  If you like the current look and feel, you can stick with this, but feel free to experiment with the other settings!
[*] [b]Epic[/b]: Crank it up to the max and enjoy the best graphics available in Planetary Settlers.  This will probably run slowly (low frames per second) though, unless you have a really nice gaming computer.  If your computer runs even this setting fast, play on and enjoy the view!
[/list]

notes.title: Alien Update!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/61347486484e290f027539b1aba2dbb3ffcf9ef2.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/9726ed4df610bd9f32d07c2d0c80f97ed1968e70.png[/img][/url]

I've been hard at work, adding new missions and achievements to the alien level (an A'kramm ship orbiting the sun), and it is released!  All medals on this level are now implemented.

Now you can negotiate with the A'kramm from a communication console (located at the bottom of the ship), which may result in several interesting outcomes / endings.  If you declare war, they will immediately destroy the sun and solar system!  Otherwise, they may try to destroy you and cause more havoc by starting another solar flare, or pursue peace depending on what you say to them.  Our fate is in your hands!

If the A'kramm try to initiate another solar flare, you can make their plan backfire by deploying nanites at key points on the ship to cause the energy pulse to destroy their ship instead!  Hurry though, you won't have much time.  You must reach these points and then escape through the portal before the ship is destroyed!

There are now three new achievements!  Stop the A'kramm in one of multiple possible ways (using the consoles at the base of the ship) to beat the first main quest and earn the winner achievement!  Replay the level and experience all the endings to unlock the "Many Worlds Interpretation" achievement.  This is a reference to the "Many Worlds Interpretation" of Quantum Mechanics.  I don't know if that interpretation is correct, but it is definitely interesting.

Can you stop the A'kramm faster than the developer, with 52 or more seconds still remaining on the clock when you finish deploying the nanites?  If so, you will earn a diamond medal, and an achievement which "Blue 42" earns the nickname "Blur 42" because of his great speed!  This will probably be the hardest achievement to get in Planetary Settlers for a while, are you up for the challenge?
